scientific.integrity: The first-step row and column accumulators, factored second moment, RMS clipping, and parameter-relative scale are reconstructed directly from the defining Adafactor algorithm. The asymptotic objective ratios are closed-form limits and the default witness is replayed at high precision.
limitations: One-step result on a \(2	imes2\) isotropic strongly convex quadratic.
The ascent family uses strong within-matrix scale separation relative to \(\epsilon_1\).
The global update-RMS clip remains satisfied; the obstruction concerns coordinate allocation.
No complete-schedule divergence claim is made.
Later guarantees with different scaling or sufficient step conditions are not contradicted.

title: Factored Adafactor can ascend an isotropic quadratic at its default first step
